tabs.content:
.create table fraud_alerts (
    transaction_id: string,
    user_id: string,
    amount: real,
    merchant_name: string,
    EventProcessedUtcTime: datetime,
    customerName: string,
    customerEmail: string
)

.alter table CCTransactions policy streamingingestion '{"IsEnabled": false}'

.alter table fraud_alerts policy update
@'[{"IsEnabled": true, "Source": "CCTransactions", "Query": "FraudEnrichment()", "IsTransactional": true}]'

.alter table CCTransactions policy streamingingestion '{"IsEnabled": true}'



.create-or-alter function FraudEnrichment() {
    CCTransactions
    | where is_fraud == 1
    | join kind=inner (
        Customers
        | project user_id, customerName = strcat(first_name, " ", last_name) , customerEmail = email
    ) on user_id
    | project 
        transaction_id,
        user_id,
        amount,
        merchant_name,
        EventProcessedUtcTime,
        customerName,
        customerEmail
}

// Use 'take' to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.
fraud_alerts
